title: MakeMyTrip's India arm gets Sebi nod to float IPO
summary: MakeMyTrip India arm receives SEBI approval to proceed with public stock offering
detailed: MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary received Sebi's final observations to proceed with an initial public offering (IPO).
The proposed IPO consists of an equity share sale by parent company MakeMyTrip and subsidiary ibibo Group Holdings.
Proceeds from the share sale will be utilized for long-term growth, strategic inorganic initiatives, and securities repurchases.
MakeMyTrip reported a net profit of $1.8 million and revenues of $235.2 million for the second quarter of FY27.
sentences: Nasdaq-listed travel booking platform MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary has received Sebi's approval to launch an initial public offering (IPO), according to an update available on the markets regulator's website.
MakeMyTrip (India) Ltd (MMT India) had filed draft papers with Sebi in July through the confidential route.
After examining the draft documents, the regulator issued its final observations on November 6.
Sebi's observations mark an important step in the IPO process, allowing the company to proceed with preparations for its public issues, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.

The proposed IPO is expected to comprise a sale of equity shares in MMT India by its parent MakeMyTrip and its wholly-owned subsidiary, ibibo Group Holdings (Singapore) Pte Ltd, the Gurugram-headquartered company said in a regulatory filing with Nasdaq.

Following the completion of the proposed IPO, MMT India will continue to remain a subsidiary of MakeMyTrip, with its financial results continuing to be consolidated with those of the parent company, it had said.

"MakeMyTrip expects the proposed initial public offering and listing of MMT India to enhance its brand visibility and support MMT India's ability to incentivise and promote talent in a competitive technology recruitment landscape," the filing stated.
The net proceeds received by MakeMyTrip and ibibo Group Holdings from the sale of shares in MMT India are expected to strengthen the parent's cash position.

The proceeds will be utilised for long-term growth, strategic inorganic initiatives and repurchases of different classes of securities, including convertible securities, by MakeMyTrip, the filing stated.
MakeMyTrip swung back into profit for the three months ending September, 2026 boosted by increased booking across all categories.
The company reported a net profit of $1.8 million for the second quarter of FY27 as compared to loss of $5.7 million in the similar period a year ago.
The revenue for the second quarter touched $235.2 million which was a 11.2% increase when compared to the similar period of last fiscal.
